lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Let's finish with one version everyone can repeat. Daniel, where are we now?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I've been revising the three feedback locations. So far, I've added the purpose line and the numbered handoff; the contact table is in progress.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I've checked the new wording against the clarified brief. The audience, one-page limit and five operational sections are unchanged.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I've confirmed that the accessible side entrance opens at eight thirty. The role-based extensions in the contact chain are also correct.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Good. Here's what we agreed: Daniel will upload version 0.8 by two, including the three-row contact table.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Agreed. Does version 0.8 also need the backup greeter's name?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Not yet. Use the role label “backup greeter” until the assignment is confirmed.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I see your point about avoiding a blank, but we should mark the name as the only open point.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: That works. The role and handoff process are confirmed even if the person is not.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Then Lena owns the wording check at three, and Sam owns the logistics verification at three fifteen.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Who signs off after those checks?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I will give final approval by four. This depends on both checks being recorded in the file comments.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: What happens if the backup name is still unknown at four?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: The internal review can close with the role label. The only open point is the person's name, due from me Friday at ten.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: And distribution?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I will send the final PDF only to the two opening-hour greeters by Friday noon. It is not a public handout.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Let me reformulate the full chain: I upload version 0.8 by two; Lena checks wording at three; Sam verifies logistics at three fifteen; Priya signs off by four and fills the backup name by Friday at ten.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Then Priya sends the PDF by noon. The approved scope stays internal, one page and operational only.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Correct. I'll send a meeting summary today so nobody treats a suggestion or placeholder as a finished assignment.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Good. The summary should link version 0.8 and state that it supersedes the earlier draft after sign-off.
